theme: Layers of glass that cancel the reflection
title: Coating the Lens: Worst-Case Anti-Reflection Stack Design
strategies: single-layer baseline: index closest to sqrt(n0*n_sub), nominal normal-incidence quarter-wave thickness (reproduces the checker baseline B, ~0.1)

nominal-only greedy: search material sequences and thicknesses to minimize reflectance AT theta0=0 with NO thickness error -- finds a razor-sharp nominal null that a real coating run and any off-axis ray immediately destroy

worst-case-robust strong: phase-matches each candidate stack to the CENTER of the angle range (not normal incidence) and selects/refines using the checker's own exact worst-case objective (all 3^L tolerance combos x the full angle grid) -- trades a shallower nominal minimum for a broad plateau that survives both angle sweep and deposition drift
invalid: material index out of [1,K] -> rejected
